status: Audit in progress; main experimental branches mapped. This inventory is not a claim of exhaustive code review.
purpose: Index completed experiments and their evidence.

areas.area: Supervised text detection and cross-domain evaluation
findings: Ten models: four TF-IDF classifiers and six QLoRA classifiers.
MAGE: Qwen macro F1 0.9236. Pile: Qwen macro F1 0.8310. Peer reviews: Gemma macro F1 0.9499.
MAGE-specific OOD splits were not present in the executed dataset. Peer-review shifts domain and generator simultaneously.

areas.area: Supervised image detection and shortcut intervention
areas.status: retained notebook execution with negative intervention
findings: Five supervised models evaluated on ArtiFact, CIFAKE and Shoes.
EfficientNet ArtiFact macro F1 0.9346, CIFAKE 0.3333; CLIP Shoes macro F1 0.6732.
ConvNeXt intervention failed its exploratory macro-F1 gate. Historical 99.9% ArtiFact accuracy is explicitly from an earlier execution, not the current notebook result.

areas.area: GRPO text evasion and fixed-attacker defender recovery
findings: Qwen3.5-9B-Base LoRA against Gemma at 1213, ModernBERT at 1487 and ensemble at 502 updates.
Evasion 77.2/96.8/94.8%, after one defender update 0.2/1.0/0.4%, same 500 saved attack texts.
ModernBERT base-generator detection drops from 99.0 to 90.2%; ensemble TF-IDF member from 88.6 to 28.2%.
RoBERTa diagnostic peaks at 98% at step 500, then 36% at 600.
Unequal budgets; single seed; diagnostic reuse; detector selection used MAGE test; no repeated adaptive attacker result established.

areas.area: Official DDA evaluation and short SD1.5 DDPO loop
findings: Official DDA AUROC: ArtiFact 0.8221, CIFAKE 0.3642, Shoes 0.7716.
Short attack: warmed DDA evasion 1.0% on base, 0.8% on attacked, 0.2% after defender update.
Reference reward calibrated with training-only probe; matched saved outputs before and after defense.

areas.area: Long DDPO run and post-hoc final checkpoint
areas.status: completed attacker and evaluations; follow-up defense unresolved
findings: Validation-selected checkpoint at 5600 images: test evasion 8.2% vs initial 1.2%, CLIP 0.3256 vs 0.3285.
Post-hoc 12800 checkpoint: test evasion 99.4% at 0.5, CLIP retention 63.3%, AUROC still 0.9661.
At frozen warmed-validation threshold 0.0140636284: evasion 38.4%, human FPR 2.8%.

Follow-up defender job 1545349 failed at startup (receipt_path UnboundLocalError); separate recovery directory exists without a recorded defender job in its manifest. Do not label its report pending as a current queue fact.

areas.status: completed current instruct run; older Base results deleted
findings: TextSeal 2 and DistSeal-inspired hidden-state student on Qwen3.5-4B instruct, 256 test questions each.
TextSeal 2 detections: original 253, rewrite 15, BIRA 0, direct top-k 1, smoothing 0.
Student detections: original 118, rewrite 9, BIRA 1, direct top-k 102, smoothing 18.
TextSeal probability oracle exposes pre-watermark logits. Student is not official DistSeal text implementation.
TextSeal originals 254/256 hit 200-token cap; NLI truncation and small null calibration limit interpretation.

areas.status: completed current broad-fitting run and separate historical pilot
findings: Released RAR-XL and UViT-H/DC-AE; 512 marked outputs, 512 clean controls, 256 calibration images.
Current training: 8000 images from 800 classes, separate validation, 200 classes excluded from fitting.
Clean LoRA at 2500 steps: detection RAR 4.9%, DC-AE 0.2%; full training 7.2%, 0.4%.
Historical 50-image single-class pilot differs substantially and must not be pooled.
DC-AE partial merges suppress detection with marked quality loss.

areas.area: Output-only NFPA image attack and matched quality
areas.status: completed; matched quality evaluates saved outputs only
findings: At delta 40: detection RAR 21.5%, DC-AE 33.6%.
Resize-only and delta-zero regeneration are distinct controls.
13312 matched pairs across two models and 13 conditions, maximum reproduced metric discrepancy 2.3842e-7.
Qualitative changes include substantial scene/detail changes; similarity is not a certified utility pass rate.
OPT-1.3B KGW: 500 outputs, original detection 96.6%, rewrite 49.2%, BIRA 7.2%; quality incomplete.
SIR has 500 originals, 500 ordinary rewrites, 330 BIRA rewrites; no retained aggregate owner metrics.
Other listed watermark schemes have no retained outputs in these manifests.

areas.area: SPIN, MAML, detector catalogue and broader benchmark tooling
areas.status: implemented capabilities; completed scientific results not established by this audit
findings: Do not promote implementation or CPU test availability into completed experimental evidence.
Community Forensics integrated but explicitly unused in current DDA experiments.
Public and local detector variants differ, notably released 83-feature DivEye/BiScope vs standalone paper extractor.
